review_policy: AI-written candidates (pending_review) until approved with scripts/review_content.py.

prompts.title: Introduce yourself
prompts.instruction: Introduce yourself. Say your name, where you are from, and what you usually do every day.

prompts.title: Your last weekend
prompts.instruction: Talk about what you did last weekend. Where did you go, who were you with, and what did you do?

prompts.title: Your home town
prompts.instruction: Describe your home town. Compare it with a big city you know: which one is bigger, busier or more interesting?

prompts.title: Something you are proud of
prompts.instruction: Talk about something you have done that you are proud of. When did it happen and why was it important to you?

prompts.title: Plans for free time
prompts.instruction: What will you do if you have some free time next month? And what would you do if you had a whole year off?

prompts.title: Directions to your favourite café
prompts.instruction: Explain how to get from your home to your favourite café. Say what is next to it, opposite it, and when it is open.
